source: make a animal hospital game. Lobby: have 3 pad each pad can have 5 max has a lovby road hospital glow and walls on edge in game 10 medicine 2 floors check in and others coffee 3d

image_prompt.text: Walkable circulation chaining the lobby to the check-in desk, the coffee area and the treatment rooms upstairs
A road running up to the hospital entrance
Task stations in the vet loop - the check-in desk and the animal treatment beds
a two-storey animal hospital building with a glowing exterior
walls closing off the edge of the play area
three seating pads laid out in the lobby
a coffee area with seating off the lobby
ten medicine cabinets or shelves distributed through the building

layout_placement.text: Check-in and treatment stations registered as the repeatable job loop
three lobby pads, each holding at most five occupants

notes: P3 and P2 are forced by free text, not by any option: a two-floor interior needs inside-outside transition and a stacked upper floor, and Simulation has no enterable-interior option to carry that cost.
The prompt is heavily abbreviated; pad, 5 max and 10 medicine were read as seating pads with a five-player cap and ten medicine props, but all three are guesses.

open_questions.ask: What is a pad here - a seating area, a player spawn, or a treatment station? And is the max of 5 players or seats?
Is 10 medicine ten pickup items, ten cabinets, or a stock counter?
No theme was stated - clean modern clinic, or bright cartoon vet?

coverage_missing.ask: What does a pad hold - players, seats, or animals?
Are the ten medicine items props, pickups, or an inventory number?
What visual style should the hospital be?
What does a player actually do - treat animals as a vet, or bring a pet in as a patient?

answers.ask: What is a pad here - a seating area, a player spawn, or a treatment station? And is the max of 5 players or seats?
answers.answer: Each pad is a player spawn pad, with a maximum of 5 players on each pad.

answers.ask: Is 10 medicine ten pickup items, ten cabinets, or a stock counter?
answers.answer: Use 10 medicine pickup items in the hospital.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - clean modern clinic, or bright cartoon vet?
answers.answer: Make it a clean modern animal clinic.
